decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.7496. Series context: trend strength 0.9931 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.06); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.628.
